concepts.summary: Keyed state (ValueState/MapState/...) is lost on restart without checkpointing; windows and dedup silently reset.
CheckpointingMode.EXACTLY_ONCE barriers align snapshots; AT_LEAST_ONCE skips alignment for throughput and delivers duplicates.
Savepoints are manually triggered snapshots for upgrades/re-scaling; their presence signals an operational upgrade path.
Managed Service for Apache Flink scales via auto_scaling_enabled; without it, parallelism is fixed at deployment.
